addSupportedToken(address).details: Expose token storage functions - Add a new supported token

params.tokenAddress: Address of the token to add

borrowFromAave(address,uint256,uint256).details: Borrow tokens from Aave against deposited collateral

params.interestRateMode: Interest rate mode (1 for stable, 2 for variable)

breakTimelock(address).details: Allows users to withdraw funds outside the normal window by paying a fee penalty This is a timelock break mechanism that allows users to withdraw their funds early

canWithdraw().details: Checks if withdrawal window is currently active

returns._0: Boolean indicating if withdrawals are currently allowed

constructor.details: Initialize the contract with initial token supply and dependencies

deposit(address,uint256).details: Deposit any supported ERC20 token into savings and then to Aave

executeEmergencyWithdrawal(address).details: Execute emergency withdrawal of all funds from Aave

getBalance(address,address).details: Gets a user's balance for a specific token

getSupportedTokens(uint256,uint256).details: Get list of all supported tokens through token storage

params.count: Maximum number of tokens to return

getUserAccountData().details: Get user account data from Aave

getUserCollateral(address).details: Get user's collateral balance for a specific token

getUserDebt(address).details: Get user's debt information for a specific token

returns.totalDebt: Total debt across all interest rate modes

returns._0: healthFactor Current health factor (in ray units, 1e27)

initiateEmergencyWithdrawal().details: Initiate emergency withdrawal process with timelock

owner().details: Returns the current owner of the contract

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

params.amount: Amount to repay (use type(uint256).max for full repayment)
params.interestRateMode: Interest rate mode (1 for stable, 2 for variable)

resumeOperations().details: Resume contract operations after circuit breaker (owner only)

setUseTokenAsCollateral(address,bool).details: Set token as collateral for the calling user

params.tokenAddress: Address of token to use as collateral
params.useAsCollateral: True if token should be used as collateral

transferAllOwnership(address).details: Transfer ownership of both this contract and related contracts

params.newTimeThreshold: New threshold for time between withdrawals

updateEarlyWithdrawalFee(uint256).details: Update the early withdrawal fee percentage (owner only)

params.newFeePercent: New fee percentage in basis points (e.g., 200 for 2%)

withdrawPenaltyFees(address,address).details: Allows the owner to withdraw early withdrawal penalty fees

params.recipient: Address that will receive the fees
params.tokenAddress: Address of the token to withdraw
